changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: Record the verifier's employee id next to the name in verified_by, the way attendance and regularization records already store approved_by alongside approved_by_id. The name used to arrive as a request parameter and was the only thing kept, so a movement record named whoever the caller typed and there was no identity on the row at all. The name is now stamped from the session, and the id makes it an identity rather than a label: two people can share a name and a person can change theirs. Rows verified before this column exists keep a null here and still show the name they were stamped with.
